snippet.title: Halo CE Campaign Mod - Operation: Solar Flare
snippet.description:
What's going on everyone and welcome back to another Halo CE mod showcase! In this video, we check out a mod where you take part in the Siege of Paris IV with pre-2000s art-style and classic-esque gameplay. This is Operation: Solar Flare, created by Shigure!

Download link: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3377314874

►Become a Channel Member: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCs_n7eqIvJhdzz4vWM2aiLQ/join
►Subscribe: https://www.youtube.com/c/xXBarthXx
►Twitch: https://www.twitch.tv/xxbarthxx
►Twitter/X: https://twitter.com/_xXBarthXx_

You play as Zulu 1, the leader of fireteam Zulu, a Spartan III commando team. Take part in the Siege of Paris IV with pre-2000s art-style and classic-esque gameplay.

== Foreword ==

Solar Flare is a single mission, originally going to be a small campaign meant to mimic pre-2000s FPS games like Half-Life in terms of look and feel. It ended up being more time consuming than I thought, but I pushed through and used it as a learning experience for the engine.

While this could've used more polish, after half a year of doing this I needed to eventually call it finished. I am however working on a proper CE campaign, one I've been developing for roughly a year or two. Solar Flare can be considered a gameplay (but not visual) demo of that.

This mod is also a snippet set in the Project Daybreak timeline of the Halo Universe, please check it out!

== Tips ==

 Normal difficulty recommended for a first time play-through, it's a long mission.
 You may need to adjust your aspect ratio/resolution to see the radar display
 The assault rifle, needle rifle and plasma suppressor all have alternate fire modes that are used with your grenade key. They are a grenade launcher, shotgun blast, and tracking explosive shot, respectively.
 The rocket launcher (named missile launcher) tracks targets when you aim at them.
 The Kangaroo APC/IFV has an alternate fire mode too.
The sniper and anti-material rifle deal BONUS damage to vehicles.
Grenades do POOR damage to vehicles, but the physics can flip ghosts.

== Known issues ==

This mod is NOT DESIGNED FOR CO-OP, it will break.
Display for button icons on controller are broken.

== Credits ==

VKMT team - Assets
Digsite team - Assets
FakeYou - Voices
Halo Modding Reclaimers Discord server - for all the help
